vibe: Premium B2B Enterprise Consulting, similar to McKinsey/Bain/Deloitte but modern SaaS. Highly analytical, functional, yet aesthetically crisp and authoritative.

rules: Use tight letter spacing for headings.
Never center paragraphs or data blocks, left-align for clarity.
Use JetBrains Mono for SKU IDs, Cost Data, and Margins for columnar alignment.

layout.spacing_scale: Generous padding (p-6, p-8) within container boundaries.
layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid (Dense, Data Correlation). Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gap: gap-4 or gap-6.
patterns: Progressive Disclosure: Show top-level metric (Health Score, Total Spend) first, hide details behind tabs/accordions.
Modular Widgets: Standardized widget sizes with subgrid alignment.
Cardless or 1px minimal borders for dashboard surfaces (The 'Grid Borders' tech look). No heavy drop shadows.

components.cards: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-6 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-400
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-300 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors
buttons.accent: bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors

components.inputs: bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent
components.tables: w-full text-left text-sm text-slate-600. Th should be uppercase, tracking-wider, text-xs text-slate-500 bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200.
components.badges: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border

interactive_elements.hover_states: Buttons and links must explicitly define hover colors.
interactive_elements.motion: Use subtle transitions (0.2s ease) on hover/focus. Animate chat sidebar sliding in from the right.

icons_and_assets.icon_style: Duotone or Regular weight, strictly functional.

consultant_avatar.description: Professional consultant avatar for the AI assistant or user profile.

testing_rules.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based format (e.g., data-testid='start-review-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust, functional sidebar layout with global navigation.
Implement the 'Start New Procurement Review' as a wizard (stepper pattern).
For the dynamic forms, heavily customize Shadcn/UI Form primitives (remove the standard look, make it sharp).
For document upload, implement a functional drag-and-drop zone using standard HTML5 or specialized library.
The Resource Cost Benchmarking should use a data-dense table pattern with JetBrains Mono monospace fonts for numeric values.
SLA and Contract Risk panels should use progressive disclosure (accordion or tabs) with semantic colored badges (emerald for strong SLA, rose for high risk).
Integrate an AI Chat Sidebar (sliding out from right) equipped with message history and consulting-like prompts.
Ensure the entire app is styled with the Swiss & High-Contrast archetype (stark white, slate borders, deep navy primary actions).
Remember to include data-testid on every interactive button, input, and critical UI element.
Install the correct icon library: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
